title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young half-fae, half-human who duels Akul, discovers a dormant fae power, is abandoned by his father Oko and then joins Ral Zarek.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fae trickster and Kellan's father who engineered the capture and the Sterling raid to steal Akul's medallion, abandoning Kellan.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: The dragon leader of the Hellspurs who swallows thunder and fights Kellan in a duel to the death.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A sharpshooter who protests leaving Kellan behind but reluctantly goes on to the vault.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who turns Hellspurs to stone and resents Oko keeping his plan secret.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A skeleton thief who hid in Oko's bone armor and frees the crew with a key.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads the Sterling army on Tarnation and later frees Kellan to enlist his help in sealing the vault.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren who is waiting near the vault entrance.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin who has been looking after Annie's thunder rifle.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: The Sterling Company leader to whom Oko leaked Tarnation's coordinates.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A friend of Ral and Kellan who would not forgive harm to Kellan.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Akul's outlaw gang, who watch the duel and fight the Sterling raid.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: The company whose army raids Tarnation and imprisons Kellan.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The Hellspur city with a molten clock tower and dueling grounds, raided by the Sterling Company.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: The vault whose power Oko, Ral and others seek.

entities.name: The medallion
entities.description: Akul's medallion holding the six pieces of the vault key, ripped from his neck during the battle.

entities.name: Fae magic
entities.description: A dormant fae magic that awakens in Kellan and lets him lull Akul into a trance.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Portals between planes that raise the stakes of the vault's power.

events.summary: At midnight Kellan is brought to Tarnation's dueling grounds, while Oko, Vraska and Annie are chained in the stands.
events.quote: Oko, Vraska, and Annie appeared, still bound in chains.

events.summary: Akul declares the duel a fight to the death.
events.quote: "This is a fight to the death!"

events.summary: Kellan dodges Akul's attacks, but his lasso and spear fail against the dragon's scales.
events.quote: Akul's scales were too thick to pierce.

events.summary: Cornered by Akul's thunder, Kellan taps an untouched fae power and lulls the dragon into a trance.
events.quote: The dragon lost focus, thunder spinning from his teeth in a harmless sigh.

events.summary: Kellan tries to choke the entranced Akul, but his guilt breaks the spell and Akul pins him.
events.quote: Kellan was wedged beneath him, unable to move.

events.summary: The Sterling Company army led by Ral Zarek attacks Tarnation, interrupting the duel.
events.quote: The Sterling Company had found Tarnation—and they had brought an army.

events.summary: Tinybones frees the crew with a key, and Vraska petrifies the Hellspurs guarding them; Oko reveals he planned this.
events.quote: locked eyes with one after another until all of them were stone.

events.summary: Kellan retrieves Akul's fallen medallion and tosses it to Oko.
events.quote: snatched the key from the ground, and tossed it back through the flames toward Oko's waiting hand.

events.summary: A Sterling guard knocks Kellan out as Oko leaves him behind.
events.quote: instead, Oko turned for the road and left his son behind.

events.summary: Oko admits to Annie and Vraska that he leaked Tarnation's coordinates to Graywater to use the raid as a distraction, and that he brought Kellan because he knew he would get them caught.
events.quote: I brought Kellan with us because I knew he'd get us caught.

events.summary: Oko refuses to go back for Kellan and Annie reluctantly goes on to the vault.
events.quote: There was no time for a rescue mission tonight.

events.summary: Kellan wakes in a Sterling prison carriage, realizing Oko left him behind.
events.quote: The truth stung more than any wound: Oko had left him behind.

events.summary: Ral Zarek knocks out the guards and frees Kellan from the carriage.
events.quote: He leaned forward and unlocked the cuffs from Kellan's wrists

events.summary: Ral says he wants the vault's power sealed away and proposes taking back the key and locking the treasure on another plane.
events.quote: We get the key back, find the treasure inside the vault, and lock it away on another plane

relations.note: Oko is Kellan's father, but abandons him.
relations.quote: Oko turned for the road and left his son behind.

relations.note: Akul and Kellan fight in a duel to the death.
relations.quote: "Enough!" Akul snarled, spit flying through his teeth.

relations.note: Kellan joins Ral to stop Oko.
Oko steals Akul's medallion using a staged Sterling attack.
relations.quote: We needed Akul to let his guard down, and he did.
dozens more of Akul's crew whooped and jeered.

relations.note: Ral leads the Sterling army at Tarnation.
relations.quote: in the center was Ral Zarek, eyes flashing as lightning built in his palms.

relations.note: Tinybones works for Oko and will come if paid extra.
relations.quote: And Tinybones will come if I pay him extra.
